from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialEquityPoint(BaseModel):
    """A single financial data point for equity/net assets from one document."""
    fiscal_year_end: str | None = Field(description="The fiscal year end date the value corresponds to (e.g. '2022')")
    amount_signed: float | None = Field(description="The value of net assets/equity, signed (negative for deficiency)")
    metric_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact line item label from the document (e.g. 'Total Stockholders' Equity')")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The magnitude unit of the amount (e.g. 'dollars', 'thousands')")
    reporting_fiscal_year: str | None = Field(description="The fiscal year of the filing/report this data appeared in")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    equity_records: list[FinancialEquityPoint]
